events.title: Announcing Rockbeasts, an upcoming rock band management game! 🤘
events.summary: Welcome to Rockbeasts! The upcoming rock band management game from Lichthund and Team17! 🎸 Lead a band of misfits on a roller-coaster ride to stardom in the age of MTV, rock anthems, and bad haircuts. Rockbeasts is a story-driven, role-playing management game that puts you in the shoes of a manager of an up-and-coming rock band. Your job – take them to the top. Will you stay true to your art?
